item.title: I'm loving Assassin's Creed 3, why was it so hated?
item.description:
It has such a unique setting, i love everything about it. It's such a breath of fresh air after the Ezio fatigue from 3 Ezio games in a row, specially with the last one being pro muslim anti christian garbage.

This one is fun and I like Connor, why people hate him? Though i hate how he was named, "you are a hideous indian mothafuka, so le'ts say you're from spain" except nobody ever says he's from Spain or confuses him for a spaniard and he even dresses in fe
